changes: Route-specific loading, including a separate admin bundle
3D loads only on entry by default; automatic mode is optional
Native scrolling and IntersectionObserver replace automatic GSAP/Lenis downloads
Balanced WebGL removes the extra reflection pass and caps background rendering at 30 fps
Uploaded images are resized to 1600 px and converted to compressed WebP
Published content is server-rendered, and static exports include a separate content file
Immutable asset/font/media caching; cart-only requests omit customer draft history
limits: These are compressed build sizes and rendering settings, not measured browser page-speed, LCP or FPS results.
